senses.gloss:
शौष्कल शौष्कल, i. e. शुष्कल + अ,
 I. adj. Eating flesh.
 II. m. A vendor of flesh (ŚKD.).

सौष्ठव सौष्ठव, i. e. सुष्ठु + अ, n.
 1. Excellence, beauty, Mālav. 20, 3.
 2. Excess.
 3. Fleetness, MBh. 1, 5368 (read सौष्ठवेन); lightness, suppleness, Mālav. 14, 9.
 4. A part of a drama.
 --Comp.
